title: Intel agency recruitment and blackballing interrogation
place_text: Headquarters of an unnamed US intelligence agency

tellings.quote: then I was invited to the headquarters of this agency and went through a very bruising um kind of interrogation

plain: A US intelligence agency, which he does not name, tried to recruit the physicist John Brandenburg, who argues that life on Mars was wiped out by nuclear war. Brandenburg tells Michels he was invited to the agency's headquarters and "went through a very bruising" kind of interrogation, an episode the story ties to his being recruited and then shut out. If so, an intelligence agency took a close and hostile interest in him.
